base_prompt: Turkish alternative pop, intimate live studio band, instrumental only. Warm acoustic guitar, expressive piano, melodic electric bass, real drum kit, restrained clean electric guitar. Cohesive memorable recurring two-bar lead motif, human microtiming and touch, breathing room for a future singer. No EDM drop, no genre switch, no dense synth layers, no vocals or speech. Key B minor, 100 BPM, 4/4. Lead motif: A two-bar melodic hook in B minor, starting on the dominant F#4 (quarter notes) stepping down to E4 and D4, then leaping to an octave F#5 on the first beat of the second bar, before cascading down in a breathy eighth-note triplet (D5-C#5-B4). It mimics a cold autumn wind whistling through narrow concrete streets..

timeline.name: intro
timeline.arrangement: Sparse and delicate. A fingerpicked acoustic guitar in B minor plays a gentle arpeggio, accompanied by single, quiet notes on an upright piano in a highly ambient space.

timeline.name: verse_1
timeline.arrangement: A subtle, organic kick pulse on beats 1 and 3, paired with soft rim clicks on 4. A warm, melodic bassline enters, sliding smoothly between chord roots to support the close, dry vocal.

timeline.name: pre_1
timeline.arrangement: Dynamic tension begins to build. A sub-bass swell introduces low-end warmth, while the piano plays ascending arpeggios and a soft shaker is introduced to drive the rhythm forward.

timeline.name: chorus_1
timeline.arrangement: Full alternative-pop arrangement. Steady, open acoustic guitar strumming combined with a live, warm snare hitting on 2 and 4. A clean electric guitar plays the signature two-bar melodic hook in the background.

timeline.name: turnaround
timeline.arrangement: The drums drop out, leaving only a soft hi-hat chick. The acoustic guitar holds sustained chords as the electric guitar's hook fades out with a warm tape delay effect.

timeline.name: verse_2
timeline.arrangement: Maintains a slightly higher energy than Verse 1. Rim clicks are replaced with a soft snare cross-stick, and the bassline plays subtle melodic fills in its upper register to complement the moving story.

timeline.name: pre_2
timeline.arrangement: The build-up repeats but with a low, rolling tom pattern and an expansive, warm synthesizer pad to maximize the anticipation.

timeline.name: chorus_2
timeline.arrangement: Identical to Chorus 1 in structure, but bolstered by ambient, swelling electric guitar textures in the stereo sides to create a wider, more enveloping soundstage.

timeline.name: bridge
timeline.arrangement: A stark contrast. The acoustic guitar and drums stop completely. A warm Rhodes electric piano plays jazz-influenced chords under an intimate, dry, spoken-word-like vocal delivery.

timeline.name: final_chorus
timeline.arrangement: The emotional climax. The full band returns with maximum energy, adding a subtle tambourine on the offbeats. The bassline locks tightly with the acoustic guitar, and the melodic hook is played with slightly more overdrive.

timeline.name: outro
timeline.arrangement: The energy dissipates. Drums and bass drop out, leaving only the delicate fingerpicked acoustic guitar from the intro. The piano plays a final, unresolved Bm chord that decays into silence.
